instruction: An intimate studio portrait photograph captured in a medium shot at eye-level. In a minimalist indoor studio with a plain off-white background, the redhead woman (R1) is seated on a low white block on the left, wearing a light blue shirt tied at the waist over a brown top and beige skirt, looking down with a gentle, serene expression. Standing behind her on the right, the dark-haired woman (R2) wears a beige blazer, leaning her head affectionately on her friend's shoulder and resting her right hand on her friend's arm while looking directly at the camera with a calm, gentle expression. The scene is illuminated by soft, diffused studio lighting, creating a warm, clean color palette.
